limitations.note: The patch left yellow and red combinational instead of registering them on the rising edge using the pre-update balance and current boost input.

limitations.quote: A recharge is credited before the same clock edge’s mode fee is deducted.
limitations.note: The rewrite changed recharge cycles to add money and deduct a fee on the same edge, whereas the original and correct implementations give recharge priority and deduct no fee when set is high.
After changing boost without a clock edge, the test expected red to change immediately, so it endorsed the combinational behavior that the fix needed to remove.
